# Hasibu (1.0.14+15)
> Çok şubeli kurumsal PDKS, yüz okutma terminali, QR/GPS yoklama, vardiya, izin ve şifreli dijital özlük platformu.

## What is Hasibu?
Hasibu is an offline-first enterprise attendance (PDKS), shift scheduling, leave tracking, and digital personnel dossier platform developed by Akarworks (Akar Bilişim Teknolojileri). Engineered in 2026 for factories, workshops, and multi-branch teams across Android, iOS, and Windows ARM64, Hasibu stores employee, shift, and attendance records locally inside a SQLCipher AES-256 encrypted database with 0 central tracking servers and 0 third-party ads. Authorized managers monitor real-time check-ins across isolated branches, verify field staff via 30-second HMAC-SHA1 TOTP QR and GPS validation, synchronize Tenfei D35 or ZKTeco face terminals through a Windows x64 branch bridge, and export multi-day CSV attendance reports. Password recovery issues 6-digit single-use verification codes through optional Gmail API integration. All optional Google Drive backups use client-side AES-256-GCM encryption under the restricted drive.file scope, supporting Turkish (tr-TR) and English (en-US) workflows.

## Core Capabilities
- Live Attendance Dashboard with multi-branch scoping (`allowedBranchIds`) and strict supervisor isolation.
- Tenfei D35 / ZKTeco TCP/IP terminal sync and Windows x64 background branch bridge (`hasibu_branch_inbox_<slug>.enc`).
- Dynamic 30-second HMAC-SHA1 TOTP QR & GPS check-in verification.
- Multi-day attendance/absence report filtering and one-tap CSV export.
- Unified auto sign-in with first-setup admin password shield and 6-digit Gmail OTP password recovery.
- Encrypted digital personnel dossier (`.hasibu_doc`, AES-256-GCM) with mandatory/optional document checklist.
